The '''Western Provinces Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in the western provinces of [[Gielinor]], such as the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]], [[Feldip Hills]], [[Tirannwn]], and [[Ape Atoll]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from the [[Elder Gnome child]] just south of the [[Grand Tree]] in the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Easy==

*{{SCP|Mining|15|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|4. Complete a lap of the [[Gnome Stronghold Agility Course|Gnome agility course]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|5. Score a goal in a [[Gnome Ball|Gnomeball]] match.
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|6. Claim any [[Chompy bird hat]] from [[Rantz]].
''Note: You need to have a ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]] in your inventory to claim hats.''

*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]]

*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Rune Mysteries]]

|11. Kill a [[Terrorbird]] in the Terrorbird enclosure.

|
*[[Weaponry]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Western banner 1]]:
**Depicts a [[chompy bird]]
**No benefits aside from being a [[crush weapon]]
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*25% chance of two [[chompy bird]]s appearing at once when [[chompy bird hunting]]
*[[Rantz]] offers you 25 [[ogre arrow]]s for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ogre arrow|25}}}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]

===Rewards===
*[[Western banner 2]]:
**Depicts [[King Awowogei]]
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 40
*50% chance of two [[chompy bird]]s appearing at once when [[chompy bird hunting]]
*[[Rantz]] offers you 50 [[ogre arrow]]s for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ogre arrow|50}}}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*The [[crystal saw]] will now hold up to 56 charges, up from 28

''Note: You need to have a ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]] in your inventory to claim hats.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]]
*[[Ogre bellows]], ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]], and [[ogre arrows|ogre]] or [[brutal arrows]]

|-
|13. Pickpocket a [[Gnome]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|75|link=yes}} {{Boostable|y}}
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Western banner 3]]:
**Depicts a [[gnome child]]
**One daily teleport to the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 50
*[[Rantz]] offers you 100 [[ogre arrow]]s for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ogre arrow|100}}}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*[[Teleport crystal]]s will now hold up to 5 charges, up from 3
*The [[void knight top]] and [[void knight robe|robe]] can now be upgraded into an [[elite void top]] and [[elite void robe|robe]] for 200 [[Void Knight commendation points|commendation points]] each, by speaking to the [[Elite Void Knight]]
*Access to the room with the [[monkey skull]] in the [[Temple of Marimbo Dungeon]], allowing you to make the [[ancient gorilla greegree]]
*Access to the [[Hunting expert (Red chinchompa hunting ground)|Hunting expert]]'s private [[Red chinchompa hunting ground]]
*[[Islwyn]] now sells [[Crystal halberd]]s for 750,000 [[coins]], which can be wielded with 70 [[Attack]] and 35 [[Strength]], and you gain the ability to create them yourself (with 78 [[Crafting]] and 78 [[Smithing]])

''Note: You need to have a ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]] in your inventory to claim hats.''

*1,000 [[chompy bird|chompy]] or [[jubbly bird]] kills

*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Mourning's End Part I]]

===Rewards===
*[[Western banner 4]]:
**Depicts an [[Elf|elven]] pattern
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]]
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 70
*Two [[chompy bird]]s will always appear at once when [[chompy bird hunting]]
*Chance of receiving a [[chompy chick]] when [[chompy bird hunting]], at a rate of 1/500
*[[Rantz]] offers you 150 [[ogre arrow]]s for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ogre arrow|150}}}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*[[Nieve]]/[[Steve]] now grant as many [[slayer reward point]]s as [[Duradel]]/[[Kuradal]]
*Resurrect with full health and restored stats once per day when you reach 0 [[hitpoints]] against [[Zulrah]], allowing you to continue on with the fight (the task list of this diary will show you whether you've used this daily resurrection, and this is considered a "safe death" for [[Ironman Mode#Hardcore|Hardcore Ironman]] players)
